protocol.eligibility: The goal was discovered before decision 450 in the common intact prefix.
protocol.primary_outcome: Mean reward sum over decisions 600--1349, among eligible episodes only.
protocol.statistics: Eight training-seed means are the replicates; paired t and exhaustive sign-flip tests. The three original primary rescue contrasts and five supplemental exploratory ablation contrasts are separate Holm families; only available contrasts are listed. Other comparisons are exploratory.
protocol.current_code: Original mixed PGC code in every variant.
protocol.shadows: Two RNN states per branch, receiving its identical actual images/actions/rewards/current code. One has mixed goal snapshots, the other ordinary-grid goal snapshots.
protocol.common_prefix: All actions are copied from the intact branch for decisions 0--599. Sensor states, shadow states, rewards and hit records are checked exactly.
protocol.frozen_offset: Mean mixed-minus-grid hidden difference over decisions 450--599. Grand mean over eligible slots is separated from each episode deviation.
protocol.wrong_offset: Grand mean plus cyclic-next-eligible episode deviation, rescaled to the own episode deviation L2 norm; zero-donor failures are reported.
protocol.between_basis: First 10 eigenvectors of weighted episode-mean covariance from the prior independent 16-episode replay.
protocol.random_control: Fixed seeded rank-10 orthonormal basis in the complement of the between-episode basis. Its dynamic patch is rescaled each step to the corresponding between-basis patch L2 norm on that same branch experience.
protocol.feedback: episode_mean_feedback and wrong_mean_feedback overwrite grid-shadow h after each step. remove_episode_mean_feedback and remove_wrong_episode_mean_feedback instead overwrite mixed-shadow h. Each c state remains untouched; all other patches affect the actor only.

ablation_followup.timing: Exploratory necessity follow-up planned after the first rescue seed had been inspected.
ablation_followup.intervention: Subtract the frozen correct or wrong CENTERED episode offset from mixed hidden activity; the between variant subtracts its first-10-between-PC projection. Mixed current and goal inputs remain supplied. Feedback repeats this subtraction in h before the next recurrent update; it does not literally clamp the actual future episode mean.

protocol.future_validation: After each episode, compare the frozen past offset with the mean intact-branch mixed-minus-grid hidden difference over decisions 600--1349. Record centered hidden and centered-action-logit cosine/R2 and future mean/dynamic energy fractions. These future accumulators never affect actions, offsets, or eligibility.
caveats: A constant actor-only hidden patch is a fixed action-logit bias. A null rescue does not rule out recurrent or time-varying uses of episode information.
Between-subspace dynamic restoration includes moment-to-moment signals, not just average offsets.
All rescues reintroduce predictive information; none is a pure ordinary-grid success.
Feedback patches can leave the natural hidden-state range; violations are measured, not clipped.

Supplemental ablations subtract an estimate of predictive-input-induced episode differences, not every source of episode-associated activity. They are exploratory necessity tests added after initial rescue results.
The episode-specific offset comes from a finite past calibration window and remains frozen as goal snapshots update.
The global and wrong-episode controls use contemporaneous calibration from other batch episodes; they are diagnostic interventions, not a proposed deployable agent.
Eligibility is fixed before intervention from the common prefix. No future hidden activity enters calibration.

calibration.scope: Descriptive eligible-count-weighted averages of two calibration batches per training seed. Batch covariance fractions are averaged, not recomputed from pooled samples. These are mixed-versus-grid goal inputs within the same PGC-trained network, not comparisons of separately trained populations.

batches.scope: Post-episode diagnostic of the intact branch only. Past and future episode offsets are separately centered over the same prefix-eligible episodes. R2 is 1-SSE/target-energy without fitting or rescaling and may be negative. Actor logits remove the action-common weight direction. No future measurement enters actions, frozen offsets, or eligibility.

future_offset_validation.scope: Post-episode intact-branch diagnostic only; these future values never enter the policy, offset estimates, or eligibility. Within each seed, batch metrics are averaged using eligible counts; then seeds receive equal weight. R² is the mean of batch-level 1-SSE/target-energy values, not pooled R². Past and future episode offsets are separately centered over the same eligible episodes. No fitting or rescaling. Undefined zero-energy metrics are omitted from their average, with valid counts retained. All quantities are descriptive.

statistics: Exploratory supplement added after observing the first rescue seed, before full rescue results. The five post-handoff score contrasts form one Holm family, corrected separately for paired t and exhaustive two-sided sign-flip tests. Eight training-seed means are the replicates. CIs are marginal paired 95% t intervals; figures use SEM. Full scores and patch diagnostics are descriptive.
intervention: Subtract only the frozen centered predictive offset delta_e minus grand_delta, estimated as mixed-goal minus ordinary-goal hidden activity during the past common prefix. Underlying current and goal inputs remain predictive. This is not subtraction of the whole episode mean.
limitations: The first four arms change only actor input; feedback arms additionally modify mixed-shadow h for the next recurrent step, while c and the grid shadow remain unchanged.
Correct and wrong offsets have matched norms. Harm from both without a clear difference does not establish episode-specific information use.
The fixed offset is an estimate from a 150-step prefix and may fail to represent later changing goal and history effects.
Subtracting the predictive contribution can move hidden activity outside its natural [-1,1] range; observed violations are reported without clipping.
This identifies effects within PGC-trained models, not the cause of their training advantage over separate grid-trained models.
No future hidden states or rewards are used to estimate the offset. Other contemporary batch episodes enter the diagnostic shared/wrong controls.
